pages.text: The Body Scanner reads the transplant status, rejection, and overall stability of all 9 organ slots at a glance.$(br)Body modding is a craft — get a checkup before you cut, and always keep an eye on this body's ledger.
The Decay Purifier burns energy to cleanse waste zones in range, letting the decay debuffs left by explosions fade away.$(br)Accidents happen — plant a tower and slowly wipe the mess clean.
